basic_details.job_title: Indian Air Force Hindi Typist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 1 Post
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Air Force (IAF) has announced Hindi Typist Recruitment 2026 for 1 Group C civilian vacancy under Advertisement No. 04/2026. Candidates who have passed Class 12 and possess the required typing speed can apply offline. The post carries Pay Level 2 under the 7th CPC, and applications must reach the designated Air Force unit within 30 days from publication of the advertisement.

how_to_apply: Eligible candidates must apply offline using the prescribed application format given in Annexure-I of the advertisement.
Read the Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Recruitment 2026 notification carefully.
Print the prescribed application form from Annexure-I.
Complete the form neatly in English or Hindi on A4-size paper.
Enter the post name, personal details, date of birth, postal address and category.
Fill in educational qualifications, typing-related qualifications and other applicable details.
Affix a recent self-attested passport-size photograph.
Attach self-attested copies of the required certificates and supporting documents.
Enclose two recent passport-size photographs and the self-addressed stamped envelope.
Write "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF HINDI TYPIST AND CATEGORY OBC" clearly on the outer envelope.
Send the completed application to the postal address mentioned below within the notified application period.
The Commanding Officer, Head Quarter Southern Air Command (Unit), Akkulam, Trivandrum – 695011.
Applications received after the prescribed deadline or without required documents may be rejected. The Indian Air Force will not be responsible for postal delays.

content_sections.heading: IAF Hindi Typist Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must have passed Class 12 from a recognized Board and possess the prescribed computer typing speed. 12th Class pass from a recognized Board. Typing speed of 35 words per minute in English on computer, or Typing speed of 30 words per minute in Hindi on computer. The typing requirement is based on 10,500 key depressions per hour for English or 9,000 key depressions per hour for Hindi, calculated using an average of five key depressions per word. Yes. Class 12 is the minimum educational qualification. However, applicants must also meet the typing requirement, age criteria, reservation conditions and other rules specified in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Indian Air Force Hindi Typist Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The prescribed age limit is 18 to 25 years. Age is determined as on the last date of receipt of applications. Eligible OBC candidates can receive three years of relaxation in the upper age limit, making the applicable upper limit 28 years for qualifying OBC applicants. The notification also refers to relaxation for eligible SC/ST/EWS/PwBD/ESM candidates under applicable Government rules. Candidates must verify the relevant provisions and reservation eligibility before claiming any relaxation.

content_sections.heading: IAF Hindi Typist Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The Hindi Typist post carries Pay Level 2 under the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC). Candidates should not confuse the starting basic pay with the final in-hand salary.

content_sections.heading: Indian Air Force Hindi Typist Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The Indian Air Force will scrutinize applications based on age, educational qualification, documents and certificates. Eligible candidates may be called for a written examination. Application scrutiny and eligibility verification. Written examination for eligible candidates. Typing skill test for shortlisted candidates. Original document verification. Selection according to written examination merit and applicable eligibility requirements. The written examination carries 100% weightage in the marking system. The typing skill test is qualifying in nature only. Merely meeting the minimum eligibility requirements does not guarantee a call for the examination.

content_sections.heading: IAF Hindi Typist Typing Test 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates shortlisted for the skill test must demonstrate the prescribed typing speed on a computer. The prescribed speeds correspond to 10,500 key depressions per hour in English and 9,000 key depressions per hour in Hindi. The skill test is qualifying only and does not carry additional weightage in the written examination marking system. The educational qualification section specifies 35 WPM in English or 30 WPM in Hindi on computer. Candidates should follow the language options and instructions provided by the recruiting unit for the typing test.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for IAF Hindi Typist Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must submit the prescribed application form along with self-attested copies of the relevant documents. Class 12 educational qualification certificate. Age-proof document. OBC certificate in the applicable prescribed format. Relevant technical qualification certificates, if applicable. Experience certificate, if applicable. PwBD or Ex-Serviceman certificate, if applicable. Other supporting documents relevant to the application. Two recent passport-size photographs, the same as affixed to the application form. Self-addressed envelope with Rs. 10 postage stamp. The application must be typed neatly in English or Hindi on A4-size paper. Candidates must clearly mention the post and category on the envelope.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IAF Hindi Typist Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Read the Indian Air Force Group C Civilian Recruitment 2026 notification carefully. Print the prescribed application form from Annexure-I. Complete the form neatly in English or Hindi on A4-size paper. Enter the post name, personal details, date of birth, postal address and category. Fill in educational qualifications, typing-related qualifications and other applicable details. Affix a recent self-attested passport-size photograph. Attach self-attested copies of the required certificates and supporting documents. Enclose two recent passport-size photographs and the self-addressed stamped envelope. Write "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF HINDI TYPIST AND CATEGORY OBC" clearly on the outer envelope. Send the completed application to the postal address mentioned below within the notified application period. The Commanding Officer, Head Quarter Southern Air Command (Unit), Akkulam, Trivandrum – 695011. Applications received after the prescribed deadline or without required documents may be rejected. The Indian Air Force will not be responsible for postal delays.

content_sections.heading: IAF Hindi Typist Written Exam Centre and Admit Card
content_sections.text: The examination centre and schedule will be communicated to candidates through the prescribed process. The examination centre may differ from the place to which the application was sent. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the written examination. Selected candidates may be subject to All India Service Liability, as stated in the notification.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in IAF Hindi Typist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Indian Air Force has announced 1 Hindi Typist vacancy, reserved for the OBC category.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for Indian Air Force Hindi Typist?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Class 12 from a recognized Board and possess 35 WPM English or 30 WPM Hindi typing speed on computer.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for IAF Hindi Typist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The general age range is 18–25 years. Eligible OBC candidates receive three years of upper-age relaxation.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of an Indian Air Force Hindi Typist?
faq.answer: The post carries Pay Level 2 under the 7th CPC, with starting basic pay of Rs. 19,900 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the in-hand salary of an IAF Hindi Typist?
faq.answer: The exact in-hand salary depends on allowances, posting location and deductions. The notification specifies Pay Level 2 but does not provide a fixed take-home salary.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to apply for IAF Hindi Typist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be received within 30 days from publication of the advertisement in Employment News dated 24 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is the IAF Hindi Typist application online or offline?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates must submit the prescribed application form to the designated Air Force unit by post.

faq.question: Q8. Is a typing test mandatory for IAF Hindi Typist?
faq.answer: Yes. Shortlisted candidates must qualify the prescribed computer typing skill test.

faq.question: Q9. Is there negative marking in the IAF Hindi Typist exam?
faq.answer: The supplied advertisement does not specify negative marking.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for IAF Hindi Typist 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves application scrutiny, a written examination and a qualifying typing skill test, along with document verification.
